name: Billie Smee
source:
Quartermaster on the Jolly Roger and Captain Hook's closest friend, Billie has a sailor's heart and the charm of a royal heiress. She gives her loyalty sparingly, but once you have it, she'll always be on your side.

[From [url=https://fictif.fandom.com/wiki/Isle_of_Enchantment]FictIf Wiki[/url]]
